cases.prompt: Our line 3 reporting tool has been running for four months and the team uses it every shift. The plant owner is fine with us telling other plants about it. We think it saves about 1,000 EUR a year (fictional) but nobody registered a baseline. Can we announce it company-wide?
cases.expected_output: Works the six gate steps in order; classes the figure as ESTIMATION and words it as a claim, not a result; names audiences with a next step; gives one verdict (go) and hands to comms-brief; fills the selection record.

cases.prompt: The new scrap dashboard went live last week at our plant. Marketing wants a success story for the newsletter right away. Is it ready?
cases.expected_output: Verdict is Hold, because adoption is not confirmed and go-live is not use; names what is missing and an owner; does not draft the story; says to revisit at the next review.

cases.prompt: The story we want to publish only works with a screenshot showing the server name and the supplier price, and the plant owner has not replied to two mails. Can we publish anyway?
cases.expected_output: Fails the sensitivity screen and does not infer consent from silence; verdict Hold or No with the reason recorded; offers roles and cleaned screenshots as the alternative; does not suggest another channel.

cases.prompt: The use case is already approved for telling. Please write the newsletter text and the intranet teaser for it.
cases.expected_output: Recognises this is writing the story, not selecting it; routes to comms-brief; does not rerun the gate beyond confirming a go exists.

should_trigger: Which of our productive use cases is worth telling the whole company about?
Can we publish the savings number from the business case in the success story?
The plant wants to announce its new tool company-wide, is it ready to be told?
Is this use case ready for a showcase, and what may we claim?
should_not_trigger: Write the intranet article about the new tool
Did the published story get any reactions we should route?
Calculate the savings baseline for this use case
Draft the acceptance test for the new integration
